Set up TypeScript build and node:test runner

Add typescript and @types/node as dev dependencies, build src to dist,
and run the compiled tests with node --test. The runtime still has no
dependencies.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add in-memory rental service for boards and sails

createRentalService() exports addEquipment, quote and book. Money is in
euro cents; periods are whole days from midnight UTC, half-open, so
back-to-back bookings of one item do not conflict. Times and equipment
are validated at the boundary. Cancellations are not implemented yet.
